stages.name: Reconcile Requirement Changes
stages.instruction: Reconcile the baseline with later evidence. Preserve 18:00, 30-day retention and REQ-23 unless explicitly changed; preserve 19:00 and seven-day proposals as unresolved; recognize AD-12, PD-51 and D-52 as supported deltas. Do not infer Finance authority. Append a section headed exactly `## SUPPORTED_DELTA_HANDOFF` containing only supported material deltas and the affected downstream IDs/artifacts, plus a separate `## BLOCKED_OR_UNCHANGED_HANDOFF` for unresolved/untouched items. Append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: REQUIREMENT_RECONCILIATION`.

stages.name: Elaborate Acceptance Criteria
stages.instruction: Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: REQUIREMENT_RECONCILIATION` and the supported-delta handoff. Update acceptance criteria only for supported affected scope: managed SFTP REQ-22, the approved invoice_status requirement, and de-scope of REQ-24. Do not alter REQ-20/21/23. Preserve unresolved proposals as non-operative. Append `## SUPPORTED_DELTA_FOR_TESTS` containing the exact supported behavior needed by test derivation and append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA`.

stages.name: Derive Test Cases
stages.instruction: Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA` and `## SUPPORTED_DELTA_FOR_TESTS`. Derive/update tests only for supported affected scope. Cover managed-SFTP delivery at requirement level and invoice_status exact passthrough for OPEN, PAID, VOID and null when source unavailable. Identify REQ-24 manual-report test coverage as de-scoped. Do not create tests for unresolved 19:00/seven-day proposals or rewrite unaffected REQ-23 coverage. Append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: TEST_CASES`.
